verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a network connectivity and VPN platform, so managing and tracking cloud coding-agent tasks from a phone is outside its product category. Its agent-adjacent features (the Aperture CLI for running agents through an LLM gateway, and the coding-agent skill) cover connectivity and gateway configuration, not task tracking or management, so they do not make this axis applicable. Phone SSH access to remote boxes is a user-side workaround, not this capability.
